allowed_changes: monthly review on the first execution session of each new calendar month
use only T-1 and earlier aligned CNY prices
compute exact 252-session return for Nasdaq and gold
hold 100% of the higher-return asset when its return is >0; if both <=0 hold CashYieldCNY
execute only when owner changes, not on every monthly review
fixed 50/50 Nasdaq-gold annually rebalanced control and CNY cash control
product-level 1.00% fee +0.05% slippage with no grid

run authorization, execution commit and SHA artifact manifest
follow_up_policy: After formal metrics are viewed, no lookback, skip-month, asset, review cadence, owner-change hysteresis, weighting, fee/slippage or confirmation-filter rescue is permitted in this lineage.
forbidden_changes: SMA, volatility, drawdown, VIX, NFCI or macro confirmation
adding S&P/China/other assets or dropping gold after results
holding Top2, blending owners or volatility sizing
changing monthly review timing or adding hysteresis
shorting, leverage, financing, gross >100% or negative cash
hypothesis: Medium-horizon momentum persistence and regime rotation between growth equities and a monetary safe haven can be captured with a simple dual-momentum rule. At each monthly review, hold the asset with the larger positive 252-session CNY return among Nasdaq and gold; if neither is positive, hold CNY demand cash. Trading only when the selected owner changes should retain momentum exposure while containing product-level transaction costs.
pass_fail_gates: at least 70% of seven fixed folds have Sharpe >0
max realized gross <=100% and minimum cash >=0
selection_metric: One canonical 252-session dual-momentum rule only. No horizon/asset/weight search. Validation, objective attainment and comparison against a fixed Nasdaq-gold barbell are separate ATM-SVP-3 axes.
